title: FirnR: tools for working with and simulating polar firn

creators.name: Münch, Thomas
creators.affiliation: Alfred-Wegener-Institut Helmholtz-Zentrum für Polar- und Meeresforschung

creators.name: Laepple, Thomas
creators.affiliation: Alfred-Wegener-Institut Helmholtz-Zentrum für Polar- und Meeresforschung

contributors.name: Dolman, Andrew M.
contributors.affiliation: Alfred-Wegener-Institut Helmholtz-Zentrum für Polar- und Meeresforschung

description: R package providing tools to work with and simulate polar firn, including the forward model used to simulate firn-core isotope records: accumulation of individual snowfall events, densification following Herron and Langway (1980), and firn diffusion following Johnsen et al. (2000) with diffusion lengths after Gkinis et al. (2014).
